adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` `onError`, `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` always produces a non-empty string (even when `err.data?.code` is undefined it becomes e.g. `"undefined: ..."`). Therefore `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")` will never hit the fallback, making it dead code and potentially surfacing raw error codes and untranslated `err.message` keys to users.
